account.title: Account
account.signedOut: One progress on all your devices: words, reviews, level and character sync on their own. Your account keeps it all safe even if you change phones or clear the browser, and lets you take part in the weekly ranking.
account.signedIn: Words and progress sync between the devices you are signed in on. After signing out they stay in this browser but are no longer sent.
account.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
account.syncFailed: Could not sync. Your data is safe here; we will try again later.
account.otherText: This browser holds another account’s data. Merge it into this account, or use only this account’s data? With the second choice, anything not yet sent is lost.
account.deleteText: Your words, progress, settings and league place will be permanently deleted from the server. This cannot be undone. The copy in this browser stays, but syncing stops on your other devices.
account.deleteFailed: Could not delete the account. Please try again.
account.sentText: We sent a letter to {email}. Click the link in it to confirm your email and sign in right away.
account.sentHint: The link works for a day. No letter? Check your spam folder.
account.sentAgain: Sent again. You can ask for another letter in a minute.
account.errorTooMany: Too many tries. Wait a little and try again.
account.errorUnverified: Your email is not confirmed yet. Click the link in the letter.
account.errorShort: The password must have at least {min} characters.
account.errorEmail: Check your email address and password.
account.errorSend: Could not send the letter. Please try again later.
account.verified: Your email is confirmed! You can sign in now.
account.verifiedSignedIn: Your email is confirmed and you are signed in!
account.verifyFailed: This link has expired or is not valid. Sign up again to get a new letter.

frame.title: Character frame
frame.lockedHint: Locked backgrounds open together with themes.
frame.leagueLocked: {tier} league frame: opens once you reach that league
frame.leagueHint: Gradient frames open with your league in the ranking.
